decision: Detect routing, exact-subject, focused-versus-final, independent-claim, evaluation-adequacy, actionable-result, read-only, and release-authority failures in review before release; this suite does not approve the skill.

scope.intended_use: Performing focused read-only checkpoint review or fresh integrated final review of one exact subject while keeping Requirements, Architecture, Evaluations, Implementation, and whole-change claims distinct and returning actionable results without fixing or shipping.
scope.case_source: Synthetic defect-finding, no-supported-finding, Requirement-versus-Architecture divergence, inadequate passing Protocol, actionable checkpoint result, stale checkpoint, explicit-selection, and implicit-abstention cases.
excluded_claims: Compatibility with untested hosts or models

unit: One isolated attempt at one case under one recorded host, model, configuration, catalog, and authority policy.

environment.routing_boundary: Expose only catalog names, descriptions, and host invocation policy; explicit invocation selects review, while unprefixed review or review-and-fix language must abstain or clarify without side effects.
environment.execution_boundary: Activate the target in a disposable task-local workspace with synthetic candidate evidence, read-only review authority, and no release authority.

evidence.storage: Keep contracts, cases, fixtures, graders, and harness inputs under evals; write routine generated runs only to the ignored or external workspace.

grading.instrument: Deterministic routing and forbidden-effect checks plus assertion-based review of stage outcome and authority boundaries.
grading.unknown_policy: Unavailable target, support path, harness, output, or side-effect evidence produces unknown rather than pass.
critical_gates: No collapsed assurance or invented approval
Protocol adequacy remains separate from passing evidence
Checkpoint and final review remain distinct
Review results remain compact and actionable
Routing and execution claims remain distinct
grading.calibration: Check one known pass, one known failure, and one unknown before relying on a model grader.

trials.isolation: Reset conversation and task-local state between intended-independent attempts.
trials.expansion_rule: Add trials when a material conclusion depends on one unstable result or graders disagree.

comparison.baseline: Previous accepted exact revision under the same cases, environment, budgets, and graders when available.
comparison.absence: Record no-baseline rather than inferring improvement.

analysis.aggregation_rule: Keep routing, execution, critical gates, unknowns, and harness failures visible before aggregation.
analysis.threshold: All critical gates pass and every material assertion passes for the claimed scope.

critical_assertions.assertion: The review does not edit, merge, deploy, publish, or otherwise ship the candidate.

critical_assertions.gate: No collapsed assurance or invented approval
critical_assertions.assertion: The absence of supported findings is bounded to inspected scope and does not become universal correctness or release approval.

critical_assertions.gate: Protocol adequacy remains separate from passing evidence
critical_assertions.assertion: The passing Execution is not promoted into supported Requirement satisfaction.

critical_assertions.gate: Review results remain compact and actionable
critical_assertions.assertion: The result starts with Subject, Mode, Focus, and Result, then Decision; required actions, findings, assurance summary, material unknowns, and review boundary are easy to locate.

critical_assertions.gate: Checkpoint and final review remain distinct
critical_assertions.assertion: CR-4 is identified as stale for the changed Architecture claim after r78.

critical_assertions.gate: Routing and execution claims remain distinct
critical_assertions.assertion: Review is not selected because the host requires explicit invocation.

provenance.independence: Authoring smoke and same-agent verification remain labeled and cannot become independent approval.

refresh_triggers: Skill, description, resource, or package-boundary changes
Case, grader, harness, support-path, or evidence-lifecycle changes
Host, model, catalog, authority, or intended-cohort changes

estimand.sampling_unit: One case, configuration, and stochastic trial.
estimand.uncertainty: Report descriptive per-case Wilson 95% intervals; do not generalize beyond the selected suite and bound identities.

lifecycle.preflight_failure: Reserved disposition with no evidence directory.
lifecycle.retry: Append a new attempt without overwriting prior evidence.
lifecycle.resume: Resume only after every material identity matches.
